verdict.rationale: Postman documents a Postman API for programmatically managing Postman assets and says it can be combined with the Postman CLI to integrate into CI/CD (postman-docs-5, postman-docs-6, postman-docs-41). The CLI can also run governance and linting checks on API specs in pipelines (postman-docs-22, postman-docs-32), and a gateway product is referenced for registering MCP servers (postman-docs-7). However, nothing shows gateway or API infrastructure defined as declarative config and synced from Git or CI, so this is imperative API and CLI automation rather than true GitOps/APIOps. Missing for 10: a declarative config format for gateway/API infrastructure, GitOps-style sync or reconcile from CI, drift detection, and independent corroboration.
